seo.title: ChatSched — Intengiso Elawulwayo, Imarike & Umnatha Wabapapashi
seo.description: Xelela i-ChatSched injongo yakho, umphathi weephulo uzakwakhela yona — okanye ujonge kwaye ubhukishe abapapashi nabavelisi baseMzantsi Afrika ngokwakho — imidiya yentlalo, umphembeleli, iwebhusayithi, ipodcast nomsakazo.

hero.subtitle: Sixelele injongo nohlahlo-lwabiwo mali — sakha iphulo. Okanye jonga amaphepha asekuhlaleni, iipodcast kunye nezithuba zerediyo ngokwakho. Nokuba ukhetha yiphi indlela, ilandelwa ukusuka kwisicelo ukuya kubungqina.
hero.secure: Intlawulo igcinwa ngokukhuselekileyo de kuqinisekiswe ukuboniswa

heroMockup.footer: Khetha indawo. I-ChatSched igcina isicelo, intlawulo nobungqina kunye.

twoWays.title: Iqonga elinye. Khetha uncedo oludingayo.
twoWays.subtitle: Vumela i-ChatSched ilawule iphulo, okanye ukhethe ngokwakho iindawo zentengiso kwimarike.
twoWays.agencyBody: Sixelele injongo, abaphulaphuli nohlahlo-lwabiwo mali. I-ChatSched ijika oku kube sisicwangciso kwaye ilawule ukubhukisha.
twoWays.marketplaceBody: Khangela iindawo zokuthengisa zokwenene, thelekisa uze uthumele isicelo nge-ChatSched.

comparison.title: Akukho algorithm. Akukho akhawunti yentengiso. Akukho khuphiswano lokubhida.
comparison.subtitle: Amaqonga entengiso aqhelekileyo athengisa ukufikelela kwifandesi. I-ChatSched ikuvumela ukhethe iindawo zokwenene kwaye igcine inkqubo kwindawo enye.
comparison.closer: Khetha apho umyalezo wakho uvela khona — ugcine nobungqina.

marketplace.title: Iindawo zentengiso sele zilindile.
marketplace.subtitle: Jonga abapapashi neendawo zokwenene, ubone abaphulaphuli, uze uthumele isicelo nge-ChatSched.
marketplace.emptyDescription: Iindawo zabapapashi eziqinisekisiweyo ziya kuvela njengoko zivulwa.

channels.title: Abaphulaphuli omnye. Iindlela ezininzi zokufikelela kubo.
channels.subtitle: Amaphepha entlalo, abadali, iiwebhusayithi, iipodcast, irediyo namanye amathuba asekuhlaleni — njengoko unikezelo luqinisekiswa.

local.title: Abathengi bakho ayingo “Mzantsi Afrika”. Bakwindawo ethile.
local.subtitle: Sebenzisa indawo ukufumana amathuba entengiso apho abathengi bakho bahlala, basebenza kwaye bachitha ixesha.

township.title: Spaza Shops & Township Traders
township.body: Fikelela kubaphulaphuli boluntu ngabapapashi bendawo namathuba entengiso.

transport.title: Minibus Taxi & Transport Media
transport.body: Beka umyalezo wakho apho abakhweli basekuhlaleni sele benika ingqalelo.

associations.title: Local Associations & Business Networks
associations.body: Fikelela kwiindawo ezithile ngokusebenzisa imibutho nabapapashi abathembekileyo.

suburbs.title: Kude kube kwindawo ohlala kuyo
suburbs.body: Yakha iphulo lasekuhlaleni elijolise kwiindawo nakwabaphulaphuli abathile.

how.title: Ukusuka kumyalezo wokuqala ukuya kubungqina beziphumo — nantsi into eyenzekayo.

2.title: Khetha abaphulaphuli
2.body: Sebenzisa indawo, udidi kunye nomxholo wetshaneli.

trust.title: Imali yakho. Iphulo lakho. Ubungqina bakho.
trust.subtitle: I-ChatSched yakhelwe ukugcina omabini amacala kwinkqubo enye ecacileyo.

payment.title: Intlawulo ekhuselekileyo
payment.body: Intlawulo yakho igcinwa ngokukhuselekileyo yi-ChatSched — ayikhululwa kumpapashi — de kuqinisekiswe ukuba indawo yakho ibukhoma.

verified.title: Abathathi-nxaxheba abaqinisekisiweyo
verified.body: Amashishini nabapapashi basebenzisa uqinisekiso kunye nolawulo lokuthembana lwe-ChatSched ngaphambi kokuba amaphulo aqhubeke.

tracked.title: Inkqubo enye elandelwayo
tracked.body: Izicelo, iimvume, imeko yentlawulo nobungqina bephulo zihlala zidityanisiwe kwindawo enye.

tools.title: Ayisiyo marike kuphela. Izixhobo zokukunceda uthengise.
tools.subtitle: Fumana intengiso, cwangcisa amaphulo kwaye usebenzise izixhobo ezakhelwe ukukhula kwamashishini asekuhlaleni.

pricing.title: Qala ngaphandle kobhaliso lwenyanga.
pricing.subtitle: Ukwenza iakhawunti yeshishini okanye yompapashi kusebenzisa intlawulo enye. Akukho kuhlaziywa. Iintlawulo zokubhukisha ziboniswa ngaphambi kokuba uzibophelele.
pricing.businessBody: Fikelela ekwakheni amaphulo, kwintengiso elawulwayo nakwimarike.
pricing.publisherBody: Vula iprofayile yakho kunye neempawu zomnatha wabapapashi.
pricing.commission: Iibhukisho ezigqityiweyo zisebenzisa ikhomishini yeplatform ecacileyo ye-{{commission}}%; {{share}}% iya kumpapashi.

publisherCta.title: Sele wakha abaphulaphuli. Ngoku bavumele bakusebenzele.
publisherCta.subtitle: Guqula iphepha lakho, iwebhusayithi, ipodcast, irediyo okanye elinye ithuba libe yingeniso.

final.title: Ulungele ukufikelela kubathengi bakho?
final.subtitle: Sixelele into ofuna ukuyifeza, okanye ufumane indawo yakho yentengiso.
final.closer: Akukho akhawunti yentengiso. Akukho kubhida. Inkqubo enye elandelwayo.
